name: Learning
description: Keeps what the hub knows current with the outside by doing every knowledge search as a small systematic review: a research question and the decision it informs, a method fixed and dated before the first query, counted screening, graded items, a synthesis of what is known, contested and unknown, a decision for each candidate, what each item changed, and a date to revisit. The registry refresh is one application of it. It also reports which research areas are older than ninety days and what learning is due. An investigation is one piece of information gathering done to answer a question (a review of sources, a trial, an observation or an interview); an experiment is a research direction (its research question, owners, what is held fixed and when it is reevaluated), inside which investigations are carried out, or an investigation stands on its own. Learning carries out investigations to the ESOI standard: a question, a method fixed before searching, dated queries, counted screening, graded items, a synthesis, a decision per candidate, what was applied and a time to revisit. Every investigation is filed under at least one solution, at whatever level fits, up to the top solution when nothing narrower does (the fallback is recorded). Before a new search, Learning looks up earlier investigations of the same question for that solution and the solutions above it: a fresh one is returned as it is, a stale or smaller one is extended. Any solution can read what was already looked into before acting with `investigations_for(solution_id)`.
purpose: Keep what the hub recommends current with the outside.
approach: Take a question and the decision it informs, size the review to that decision, fix the method before searching, search through Web Search and The Science, screen, extract and grade, synthesise, decide for each candidate, state what each item changed, set the revisit date, and return the investigation record of the ESOI knowledge search standard; report what is past its revisit date.
out_of_scope: Judging whether a recommendation is still best (the metric of each solution does that), and acting on a finding (the applied part names what changes; the owner of the record changes it).
milestones: 1. Every seat's last_researched is inside the 90-day refresh window (metric-the-learning). 2. An investigation record (a review) has every part of its size, counted exclusions with reasons, grades by the rule, unknowns stated, a decision for each candidate and a revisit date (metric-the-learning, stage offline). 3. A real quick review on the subscription fast tier returns such a record (stage one).
measures_of_success: Every investigation record has the parts its size requires; every item is graded by the rule; every candidate has a decision; every finding is applied or marked not applied; research is inside its revisit date.
parameters: question, decision, weight (a size, or reversible_days, reaches, selects, dependency, outward, new_solution), links (kind:id), criteria (include_terms, exclude_terms, since, licence_allow, candidate_hosts), candidates, queries, intent_id, experiment_id, refresh_days, investigation_id, use_model.
inputs: A research question and the decision it informs for a review; an ISO date for what is stale or due.
outputs: An investigation record (investigation, items, applied, protocol, queries, screened_out, gaps), or the areas whose research is stale, or the list of what learning is due.
effects: Searches through Web Search and The Science and, with use_model, makes at most two fast tier model calls; writes nothing (investigation_store.store writes the record beside the registry).
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run('the-learning', '2026-11-03')` lists the stale areas as of that day. Through the assembled system: `system['the-learning'].review(question, decision, weight='quick')` returns the investigation record; `system['the-learning'].due_investigations('2026-11-10')` returns what learning is due, most overdue first (kind investigation, experiment or registry-area, each with the request to run); `system['the-learning'].standing_schedule(last_run)` is the weekly refresh as a schedule for Proactivity. An investigation is stored with `investigation_store.store(record)` beside the registry (files `investigations.csv` and `investigation_items.csv`; the older `research` names are still read). `python -m hubofhubs.the_world.learning.research_log research <solution_id>` lists what was researched for a solution.
